title: Wonderlands×Showtime Chapter1 Episode7 The Fourth Member?

rows.Line: Kamiyama High School - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I-I don't understand!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I was waiting for you to profusely thank me for giving you the rare and significant opportunity to work alongside me!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Unfortunately, we won't be doing a show together.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You see, I like to work alone and with absolute freedom to stage any show I want.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As long as my shows fill my audience's hearts with joy, I'm perfectly satisfied.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You want to make your audience happy?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: In that case, you'd be making a mistake by not teaming up with me!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh? And why would that be?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Because you'd want me, future international super-star, on your stage!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: As a born star, I can deliver the ultimate in entertainment!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And since I've seen that show you did the other day, I can tell that you'd make an excellent stage director!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Give me any role, and I will perform it to 12,000% satisfaction!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Well, well. That's certainly impressive.
Do you have anything to back up your claims?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
You want proof? Ha! I don't have any!
But what I do have is unshakeable confidence in myself!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Allow me to turn your plays into fabulous performances! Well? Don't you think we'd make an amazing team?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I will reiterate, if I perform in a show, it's going to be a smash hit, no doubt about it!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe, you're quite a character, aren't you.
I can see that doing shows together might be exciting.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What is it? Someone you know?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
.....
Perhaps this is a good opportunity after all.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa, are you looking only for a stage director?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Huh? No, we need actors too.
If possible, I'd like you to perform, too, on top of doing stage direction.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If that's so, I will join you on the condition that you also invite a person I recommend.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Sounds good! But this person of yours had better be talented!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I can vouch for that.
We've been dabbling in theater together ever since we were little.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's terrific! I get two new troupe members in one go!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well then. Let's work together to put on some unbeatable shows!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It'll be a pleasure having you on the team, Rui!
After school
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Say hello to our new stage director!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow! You're the performer from yesterday!
Welcome, and wonderhoy☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hmm... I didn't know about this stage.
It's old, but well-maintained.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You must be the other cast member Tsukasa mentioned. I'm Rui Kamishiro. Nice to meet you.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Nice to meet you too, Rui!
Please tell me, when will you do the next part of yesterday's show?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
You watched it too?
I'm not sure when, but I can promise you that I will finish the story someday.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You really promise?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I give you my word.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe, thanks! Oh, and my name's Emu Otori!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Otori? Hm...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Rui, can we use your flying zoom-zooms in our shows here?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, my drones. Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Omigosh! Can you make them go fwooooosh?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Like shooting stars? It would certainly be fascinating to witness the formation of plasma around a drone flying at the speed of forty kilometers per second.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, but it would also be amazing if they could flutter-putter!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, yes. The unpredictable flight pattern of the blue admiral butterfly would be aesthetically pleasing, wouldn't it?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Are you two actually...communicating?
I'm so confused...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But more importantly, where is the other person you wanted to invite to the troupe?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, I came with her but she's remarkably shy.
Wait a moment, I'll go and get her.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I wonder what she's like! This is so exciting!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well, at least now we have enough members for our shows and soon the curtain shall rise on our first performance!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Apologies for the wait. Here she is.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa & Emu
rows.Line: She's a robot?!
